brief:
Al-Shaair, a linebacker for the Houston Texans, wore eye black inscribed with the name Wafaa Akila during an NFL game, according to Al Jazeera English. Akila was a Palestinian girl killed in Gaza. The gesture came despite the league previously fining Al-Shaair for displaying messages about Israel's actions in the territory.

The NFL has enforced restrictions on players' political messaging during games. Al-Shaair's decision to wear Akila's name on his face marks a continued show of solidarity with Palestinians amid the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
dek: Al-Shaair wears eye black with Akila's name despite being fined for displaying messages about Israel's genocide in Gaza.
title: NFL player honors slain Palestinian girl despite league fines
